verdict.rationale: Base44 ships a built-in managed backend database. The in-builder Data page shows every app table as a card. An independent community comment confirms the database is included within the platform rather than requiring external persistence, and SDK entities provide CRUD access from the app. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs describing automatic provisioning and schema creation from the builder, and detail on how tables are wired into app code without any setup.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a database provisioned and wired into my app without leaving the builder

citations.quote: The Data page shows every table in your app as a card. Click a card to open its records.
Maor opted to include the db within the platform, rather than enable persistence externally.
Build full-stack apps with the SDK, CLI, and a managed backend.
entities: Work with your app's data entities using CRUD operations.
